game_concept: A strategy race set in Coastal Port – Cannon Battery, the harbor cannon battery: the deckhand must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Elif Ladder: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each.
theme: Coastal Port – Cannon Battery: the harbor cannon battery
core_gameplay_loop: In Cannon Battery, repeat each round: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the deckhand ahead. Then check the threat_level value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ship's hull by solving code steps involving threat_level that move the deckhand forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ship's hull first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Elif Ladder
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Elif Ladder' (Week 3 slot 3), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Cannon Battery'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how threat_level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Cannon Battery.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
